question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing fullback, Bob is playing right winger, Claire is playing goalkeeper, Dave is playing left winger, Eve is playing left midfielder, Fred is playing right midfielder, and Gertrude is playing left back.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Claire and Alice trade positions. Then, Dave and Alice trade positions. Then, Dave and Alice trade positions. Then, Bob and Alice trade positions. Then, Claire and Gertrude trade positions. Then, Bob and Fred trade positions. Finally, Bob and Fred trade positions. At the end of the match, Eve is playing
Options:
(A) fullback
(B) right winger
(C) goalkeeper
(D) left winger
(E) left midfielder
(F) right midfielder
(G) left back
solution:
Each row lists positions in the order Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: fullback, right winger, goalkeeper, left winger, left midfielder, right midfielder, left back
1. Claire ↔ Alice: goalkeeper, right winger, fullback, left winger, left midfielder, right midfielder, left back
2. Dave ↔ Alice: left winger, right winger, fullback, goalkeeper, left midfielder, right midfielder, left back
3. Dave ↔ Alice: goalkeeper, right winger, fullback, left winger, left midfielder, right midfielder, left back
4. Bob ↔ Alice: right winger, goalkeeper, fullback, left winger, left midfielder, right midfielder, left back
5. Claire ↔ Gertrude: right winger, goalkeeper, left back, left winger, left midfielder, right midfielder, fullback
6. Bob ↔ Fred: right winger, right midfielder, left back, left winger, left midfielder, goalkeeper, fullback
7. Bob ↔ Fred: right winger, goalkeeper, left back, left winger, left midfielder, right midfielder, fullback
Eve plays left midfielder, option (E).
Final answer: (E)
